purpose: Official-source Desktop Publishing Operator curriculum for comparison with NYSC COURSE-062.
status_note: Source-inspected national curriculum awaiting independent human review.

country_group_gaps.sri_lanka: The existing Sri Lankan Graphic Designer standard is reused as related print/publish evidence; no exact Desktop Publisher standard was verified.
country_group_gaps.developed: The existing Singapore communication-design programme is reused as related design evidence; no exact developed-economy desktop-publishing curriculum was verified.

records.institution: Government of India, Directorate General of Training

modules.title_verbatim: Classify the features of Adobe PageMaker.
Create, edit, format and develop page combining text and graphics using page makeup Adobe InDesign application software.
Create Illustrations and Graphics using Adobe Illustrator.
Create, format, edit and develop images using Adobe Photoshop software.

verification.method: Trade identity, level, duration and the PageMaker, InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop text checked against official DGT PDF pages 9, 11, 13 and 19-20.

records.licence_note: Official Government of India curriculum; reuse terms not assessed.
notes: A national curriculum, not a verified named-provider delivery.
PageMaker appears in professional-knowledge content while InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop are trade-specific learning outcomes.
The NYSC headings name older software versions; the comparison records only the named applications, not version equivalence.
